title: Radical Love: Awakened Relationships and Natural Leadership - Book Outline (December 2013)
summary: Detailed chapter-by-chapter outline for a book by Judith and Melissa on Radical Love, organized into five parts covering introduction, foundations, living radical love (seeing clearly and loving passionately), case studies, and an appendix of guiding principles. The outline includes six guiding principles - personal responsibility, sharing direct experience, being authentic, knowing our self, honoring our word, and applying skillful means - with exercises, stories, and meditations for each chapter.

title: Choices Weekend Personal Discovery Form - Participant Intake Questionnaire
summary: Pre-workshop intake form for The Choices Weekend asking participants about their birth history, childhood, family relationships, health, sexuality, personal beliefs, fears, desires, and prior seminar experience. Includes emergency contact information and instructions to bring the completed form to the weekend.

title: Radical Choices Leadership in Recovery - Day Two Participant Workbook Using Disruptive Learning Technology
summary: Day Two participant workbook for the Radical Choices LLC Leadership in Recovery program (copyright 2015), covering the reactive self, personal responsibility, reactions as pitfalls (judgment, interpretation, projection), dissolving reaction, authenticity, integrity, and the six principles of DLT. Includes application activities such as personal responsibility scene studies set in recovery facility contexts and a lack-of-integrity exercise called Cleaning Up The Mess.

title: Radical Choices Disruptive Learning Technology Train the Trainer Certification - Session Three: Beyond Suffering, The Naked Bald Truth
summary: Session Three workbook for the Radical Choices LLC Train the Trainer Certification Program (copyright 2016), structured as a three-day curriculum. Day One covers nondual awareness vs. conditioned experience, archetypes, and personal Greek tragedy; Day Two focuses on clarity, DLT core perspective, and thoughts/feelings; Day Three addresses taking the learning into the world through clear mind and awakened action practices.

title: Inward Bound Institute Proposal - Touching Reality Series by Orloff Learning, Inc. (2006)
summary: Proposal from Orloff Learning, Inc. for the Inward Bound Institute's Touching Reality program series, developed in partnership with Rabbi Yehuda Shemtov of the Glazer Center. Describes a plan for world-wide programs sharing Chassidic tradition and Kabbalah teachings using modern accelerative learning methodology for Jewish spiritual education.

title: Radical Love Participant Workbook - Living the Future Now Program (RLF 2011-2012)
summary: Participant workbook for the Radical Love Foundation's Living the Future Now immersion program (Winter 2012, two weekends with weekly conference calls). Covers the conditioned/reactive self, emotions as waves of energy, birth-to-now life mapping, beliefs and sacred cows, the Mom and Dad Game, approval and disapproval patterns, true desire, negative bonding, integrity, and personal responsibility with exercises and poetry throughout.

title: Radical Love and Radical Choices Supplemental Teaching Materials - Science of Dissipative Structures and Emotional Conditioning
summary: Supplemental teaching materials for Radical Love and Radical Choices programs covering the science behind knowledge transfer using Prigogine's dissipative structures theory, Candace Pert's work on emotions as molecular processes, and the concept of cognitive dissonance as a catalyst for transformation. Includes content on personal responsibility, reactions, emotions as energy waves, and how childhood conditioning creates patterns that persist into adulthood.
